items.raw_excerpt: If you are one of those clever people who spent years studying abroad and is now contributing skills to the Dutch economy, there’s good and bad news. items.summary_en: The Netherlands is changing the 30 percent tax ruling that helps highly skilled foreign workers earn more. Some economists are worried because fewer skilled migrants have come to the country since 2023. A new tulip fund now brings top scientists to work in the Netherlands.

items.raw_excerpt: People in La Loche, Sask., and other communities in the northwest see a chance to build services and a quality of life that outlast the boom and bust cycles of a resource-based economy.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwanese senior high school students won three silver and four bronze medals at the International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence (IOAI), according to National Central University (NCU), which organized Team Taiwan.

items.raw_excerpt: Decisão facilita vida de herdeiros que têm bens a receber, como imóveis, mas não têm recursos financeiros imediatos para pagar o tributo.
items.summary_en: A new decision in Brazil removes the requirement to pay the inheritance tax before completing an extrajudicial inventory. This helps heirs who receive property but lack the immediate funds to pay the tax. The change is expected to speed up the process of transferring inherited assets.
